stories.title: PwC UK expands FloQast partnership from integration to managed finance operations
stories.summary:
FloQast announced on October 26 that PwC UK has expanded their partnership to run outsourced finance functions using its AI-enabled accounting platform.[1] The service covers month-end close, account reconciliations, accounting operations and compliance workflows, moving beyond consulting and software integration into ongoing delivery on behalf of clients.[1] A PwC UK finance managed-services leader confirms the relationship in the announcement, which describes adjustable service levels but gives no engagement prices or named customer results.[1] Faster deployment, reduced risk and improved efficiency are vendor claims rather than independently measured outcomes.[1] For an agency, the useful pattern is a narrow finance-operations engagement combining workflow integration, human review and recurring support, with audit trails and acceptance criteria defined before rollout.

Sources:
[1] https://www.floqast.com/press-releases/floqast-and-pwc-uk-expand-partnership-to-provide-tech-powered-finance-managed-services

stories.title: Marubun launches Aeolus robot security services with physical elevator-button operation
stories.summary:
Marubun announced on October 27 that it had launched security services using Aeolus Robotics robots for patrols and guard duties, according to October 28 reporting by IBTimes JP.[2] The offering extends its nursing-care robot activities into offices, commercial facilities and hospitals, with robotic arms pressing elevator buttons rather than connecting to elevator control systems.[2] The report describes image-based inspection alerts, posture detection and streaming video that lets remote staff assess incidents and speak through the robot.[2] Avoided elevator-integration costs are a company claim, not an independently verified saving; the article provides no named security customer, deployment count, service price or clinical validation.[2] This is a commercial service announcement rather than evidence of a large completed rollout or autonomous medical care. A plausible integration niche is site-readiness testing, patrol configuration and human-supervised alert handling, with maintenance responsibilities agreed with the robot supplier.

Sources:
[2] https://jp.ibtimes.com/marubun-deploys-aeolus-security-robots-that-press-elevator-buttons-105012
